# ezCORE v0.1.0 — first public build

The first public release of ezCORE: an open-source multi-system emulator
for your own game dumps. It runs a set of emulator cores behind a small
stable C ABI and gives them a console-style interface, cheat support, and
local save snapshots.

**This is an early build and things may not work as expected.** We ship
it because it is already genuinely fun, and because the fastest way to
make it better is in the open.

## What's in this build

| Platform | Artifact | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| macOS arm64 | `ezcore-0.1.0-macos-arm64.zip` | Ad-hoc signed + sandboxed; `codesign --verify --deep --strict` passes. Unzip, drag to Applications, right-click → Open the first time (no notarization yet). |
| Android arm64 | `ezcore-0.1.0-android-arm64.apk` | Release-signed; installs via `adb install` or sideload. arm64 devices only. |
| Windows / Linux | — | Shells compile on CI but no builds are published yet. |

- Cores bundled: **17** (macOS) / **10** (Android) — sameboy, gambatte,
  mGBA, Mesen, Snes9x, Genesis Plus GX, Stella, Beetle PCE, DOSBox Pure,
  ScummVM (macOS only), and more; the full per-core list lives in
  `cores/catalog.json` and `docs/MATRIX.md`.
- Verification level: 3 cores render-verified end to end (SameBoy,
  Gambatte, mGBA), the rest load-and-identify in the boot harness —
  exact per-core state is in `docs/MATRIX.md`. Frames are unverified for
  the GPU-renderer cores; treat them as experimental.
- FinalBurn Neo is **not** bundled in this release — it ships only
  after a compatibility review.

## Known limitations

- No BIOS or games are bundled. You need your own dumps; several systems
  (e.g. Beetle Saturn, ScummVM game data) also need files you must
  supply yourself.
- iOS is not shipped yet (waiting on distribution identity); Windows and
  Linux are not shipped yet.
- Cores marked experimental in `docs/MATRIX.md` (Saturn, N64, PSP,
  Dreamcast, DS, PS1) load and identify but have unverified rendering.
- Save/state formats are not frozen yet — expect changes before v1.0.
- First launch stages cores into the app's vault; it can take a moment.
- The app is sandboxed (macOS); it reads only files you pick.

## Reporting

- **Found a bug?** Open an issue with your platform and exact steps.
- **Fixed it?** PRs are welcome — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- This is still an early build: if something looks wrong, it probably
  is — tell us.
